title: pittosporum tenuifolium subsp. fasciculatum
intro: Pittosporum tenuifolium subsp. fasciculatum, commonly known as the "Mock Orange", is a species of flowering plant native to Australia and New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including coughs, colds, and skin irritations, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pittosporum tenuifolium subsp. fasciculatum include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve coughs, and soothe skin irritations, making it a popular choice for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
